hypothesis_tested: the 1.81mm came from a reduced-rank curve representation floor
evidence: Removing the floor made it worse, not better: NCTRL 16 -> 24 -> 32 gives 1.8096 -> 1.8559 -> 1.8883. And the degradation is UNIFORM across contours (1.40-1.56x) rather than tracking the floor: sup._antihelix has a 0.098mm floor yet degrades 1.41x, the same as concha at 0.976mm.
actual_cause: Under-conditioning in the implementation. fam_phase predicts all control points of a contour from ONE pooled vector (global + contour-pooled + coarse), while the base model gets per-landmark local features by kNN gather plus iterative offset-and-snap. Family F is a whole-contour regressor from a global descriptor.
consequence: Family F did not test the phase idea; it tested a weaker backbone carrying a phase head. The phase question remains open. The clean experiment is the EXISTING base backbone with a monotone-phase output head, changing one thing. Family F is set aside rather than iterated further.
